name: Amour Sucré: High School Life
source:
A move, a new city, a new high school... Welcome to Sweet Amoris!

Get to know some of your fellow students, who include two boys: Nathaniel, the student body president, nice, very serious and strict and Castiel, the school rebel, who doesn't seem too approachable.

A third boy?! Ken, a former school friend who has a crush on you and changed schools just to be near you!

[Edited from [url=http://www.mycandylove.com]My Candy Love[/url]]
translation:
搬家、新城市、新高中……欢迎来到甜蜜爱莫里斯！

认识一些你的同学，其中包括两个男孩：纳撒尼尔，学生会主席，友善，非常严肃和严格；卡斯迪奥，学校叛逆者，看起来不太平易近人。

第三个男孩？！肯，一位以前的校友，他迷恋着你，为了靠近你而转学了！

[编辑自[url=http://www.mycandylove.com]我的糖果之恋[/url]]
